endpoint_determination._question: Does this paper contain ANY cargo-expression measurement?
endpoint_determination.borderline_called_explicitly: Fig 4b,c reports the % of cells positive for an aVHH PSEUDOGENE built from scRNA-seq reads. That counts cargo mRNA molecules, not expressed protein, it is reported per transcriptional cluster for one LNP, and no per-formulation value table exists. Marked inadmissible.
evidence: Cre mRNA is the cargo of every LNP in the screens and of Cat-/Neu-/An-LNP individually. SI Methods: mRNA was transcribed from a pMA7 construct with full N1-methyl-pseudouridine substitution, Cap1, enzymatic polyadenylation.

The readout is GENOMIC RECOMBINATION: Ai14 reporter mice, in which Cre protein translated from the delivered mRNA excises a Lox-Stop cassette and the cell becomes tdTomato+. Main text: 'functional mRNA delivery is quantified as the percentage of tdTomato+ cells'. That is downstream of translation, so it is cargo expression, not particle arrival.
A second cargo-expression readout exists: Fig S17 measures % aVHH+ cells and aVHH MFI by flow cytometry after delivering mRNA encoding a GPI-anchored VHH -- protein abundance.
The corpus already carries this readout convention: SX_2025 has 141 in-vivo rows at Model_type = Mouse_Ai14 with Experiment_method = editing_efficiency_normalized.
endpoint_determination.what_the_title_refers_to_is_NOT_delivery: Figures 4a and 5 and Supplementary Figures 20-22 are single-cell RNA-seq of the LUNG'S OWN transcriptome one hour after injection -- 27 clusters, 243/145 differentially expressed genes vs PBS, 27 of 835 Reactome pathways. That is what the tissue does ABOUT the particle. It is recorded in 05_values.csv as corpus_admissible = no.

error_class_32_headroom_measured._verdict: The widest real cap is 0.647 of its bar, against a 0.90 gate -- a margin of 0.253 on 16 of 16 bars. The width sweep in seeded_selfchecks shows that a marker would have to reach the FULL bar width to be read as a top, and nothing in this figure comes close. That is what makes the error-class-32 exposure in that sweep a stated limitation rather than a live defect.
error_class_32_headroom_measured._what: How close does a REAL error-bar cap in this figure come to the 0.90 full-width coverage rule that bars.bar_top uses? Measured on all 16 readable Cat-LNP bars of Fig S13a: the widest contiguous bar-coloured run in the 26 rows above each bar's detected top.
